acceptanceCriteria: Missing Android Yandex ad unit leaves release advertising disabled and never substitutes a demo/live identifier; assembleRelease and bundleRelease remain buildable without secrets.

A separately named publication-readiness validation task rejects missing/placeholder Yandex ad unit, final privacy-policy URL/text and signing configuration, but is not a dependency of ordinary compile/test/release-candidate assembly.
CI assembles the unsigned Android release candidate in addition to debug and never signs, uploads or publishes it.

CI release documentation precisely distinguishes buildable safe-disabled release candidates from externally configured publishable releases, Firebase remains optional, and iOS ads remain untouched/safe-disabled.
No source, UI, ledger, live identifier, credential, external project or publication change; specialist does not run Gradle.
goal: Make an unsigned Android release candidate buildable and testable without live Firebase/Yandex/signing/privacy values by keeping production ads fail-closed, while providing a separate explicit publication-configuration validator and CI release assembly gate. Do not publish or create external projects.
